verbs.description: Worker takes parts from a rack, shelf or bin and puts them into a kit tray or onto the unit, hand closing on each part; may scan parts with a handheld scanner while picking. The parts move.
Worker lowers a held part onto the unit or fixture and releases it.
Worker pushes a part into a hole, slot or socket on the unit, aligning it with both hands.
Worker drives a fastener with a handheld screwdriver or torque driver held against the unit.
Worker joins a cable, plug, hose or connector to a mating part; includes crimping and wiring.
Worker holds a gas torch with a visible flame against a pipe joint.
Worker checks the assembled unit in front of them: looks closely at it, points a handheld scanner at its label, or watches a test rig connected to it. Hands mostly still; no parts move.

Worker walks across the floor away from the unit, empty-handed or carrying a part or box. In the first-person view the floor and aisle markings fill the frame. In the station camera, the worker walking out of view counts as walk.
Worker looks through bins or shelves for the right part, hands moving between containers without a clear pick.

parts.name: Galvanised base pan
parts.hint: large flat galvanised sheet-metal tray, the unit's floor; everything is built on it

parts.name: Inverter rotary compressor (R290)
parts.hint: black upright cylinder about 35 cm tall with pipe stubs on top

parts.name: 4-way reversing valve
parts.hint: small brass valve body with four copper pipe stubs and a coil on the side

parts.name: Electronic expansion valve
parts.hint: small valve with a cylindrical motor head and two thin copper pipes

parts.name: Brazed plate heat exchanger
parts.hint: rectangular stack of thin stainless plates with four round ports

parts.name: Finned evaporator coil
parts.hint: large flat block of thin aluminium fins with copper tube ends at the sides

parts.name: EC fan motor
parts.hint: compact round black motor with a mounting bracket; often carried in its small cardboard box

parts.name: Axial fan blade 550 mm
parts.hint: large black plastic propeller, about half a metre across

parts.name: Inverter PCB in e-box
parts.hint: grey or black electronics box with a circuit board and connectors

parts.name: Wiring harness (variant-specific)
parts.hint: bundle of coloured wires with plastic connectors at the ends

parts.name: Powder-coated side panel
parts.hint: large flat painted metal panel, nearly as tall as the unit

parts.name: Top cover
parts.hint: large flat painted metal lid covering the top of the unit

parts.name: Fan guard grille
parts.hint: round or square wire-mesh guard over the fan opening

parts.name: Screw M6x12 self-tapping
parts.hint: small screws, usually only visible as a screwdriver driving into sheet metal

parts.name: Screw M8x20 with nut
parts.hint: bolts with nuts, driven with a torque driver into the base or brackets

parts.name: Silver brazing ring (15% Ag)
parts.hint: tiny silver ring slipped onto a copper pipe end before brazing

parts.name: R290 refrigerant charge
parts.hint: refrigerant: not visible itself; a charging hose connected to a service port on the unit

parts.name: Carton and corner pads
parts.hint: large brown cardboard box that encloses the whole finished unit, with foam corner pads, at the packing station
